whoItsFor: Developers, SEO and GEO practitioners, and marketers who want to see how AI models describe their product and which competitors they name, and who prefer a self-hosted tool that uses their own model API keys.
useCases: Check how different AI models describe your product and which competitors they mention
Test keywords to see which brands appear in AI answers without naming your own brand
Repeat or schedule model tests to compare answers, sources, and changes over time
